test_title: PYST 20: SSC GD Constable 2025 - Reasoning (Held On: 12 Feb, 2025 - Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Seven people, L, M, N, O, W, X and Y, are sitting in a row, facing north (but not necessarily in the same order). No one sits to the left of X. Only four people sit between X and N. Only three people sit to the right of L. M sits to the immediate left of W. O is not an immediate neighbour of L. Who sits at the rightmost end of the line?
solution:
Given seven people, L, M, N, O, W, X and Y, are sitting in a row, facing north (but not necessarily in the same order).

No one sits to the left of X.

Only four people sit between X and N.

Only three people sit to the right of L.

M sits to the immediate left of W.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1b923c925b07a06f392df34f7ed3790d2676ffd81592101afeddf01776c25bd2.png] 

O is not an immediate neighbour of L.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/94b0802234ecdd71bfbf94f03b3fde9e484f643c14f5806a5517f617b082a639.png] 

And Y sits at the remaining place.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/711f48e35b40c0d51097605bf879a697eecac96c471db5798ae200b2f9e67b70.png] 

O sits at the rightmost end of the line.
